hint.text:
Question tags should not be used in formal speech and writing. Questions can still be used in formal speech and writing, but they should be written formally.

Informal: You'll come to the shops with me, right?

Formal: Will you come to the shops with me?
hint.sound: Question tags should not be used in formal speech and writing. Questions can still be used in formal speech and writing, but they should be written formally. For example, informally you could say 'You'll come to the shops with me, right?' and formally you could say 'Will you come to the shops with me?'

instruction.text: Select a formal question to replace the informal question.

b: ++<t-purple>How are you?</t-purple>
<t-purple>What’s up?</t-purple>
<t-purple>I hope you’re good.</t-purple>
++<t-purple>Could you help me?</t-purple>
<t-purple>I need help.</t-purple>
<t-purple>Can you give me a hand?</t-purple>
++<t-purple>Do you agree that it is very cold today?</t-purple>
<t-purple>Is the weather alright?</t-purple>
<t-purple>It’s well cold today.</t-purple>

atoms.a: <t-orange>I can tell you a secret, can’t I?</t-orange>
b: ++<t-purple>Could I share this secret with you?</t-purple>
<t-purple>I’ve got a secret to tell you.</t-purple>
<t-purple>Wanna know this secret?</t-purple>

instruction.text: Choose the formal question to add at the end of the sentence.

atoms.a: <t-blue>It is deplorable that people are still littering on the street.</t-blue>
b: <t-purple>Crazy how people can be that inconsiderate, right?</t-purple>
++<t-purple>How can people be so inconsiderate?</t-purple>

atoms.a: <t-blue>We must discuss the issue of homelessness in the UK.</t-blue>
b: ++<t-purple>How can we allow these people to suffer on the streets?</t-purple>
<t-purple>We cannot let these people suffer, can we?</t-purple>

atoms.a: <t-blue>The school has brought in a school uniform so that we cannot wear our own clothes.</t-blue>
b: ++<t-purple>Why has our individuality been taken away?</t-purple>
<t-purple>It is deplorable that our individuality has been taken away, isn’t it?</t-purple>

atoms.a: <t-blue>I am disappointed that large companies continue to use greenhouse gases.</t-blue>
b: ++<t-purple>How will we be able to tackle climate change?</t-purple>
<t-purple>We’ve got to beat climate change, don’t you think?</t-purple>
